---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for this project
title: "[Feature] Request Template"
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
type: Feature

---

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of the problem or missing functionality.  
Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...]

**Describe the solution you'd like**
A clear and concise description of what you want the addon to do.

**Game flavor(s)**
Which versions should this support?
- [ ] Retail
- [ ] Classic Era
- [ ] Classic Season of Discovery
- [ ] Classic TBC
- [ ] Classic WotLK
- [ ] Classic Cataclysm
- [ ] Classic MoP
- [ ] Forever / other private
- [ ] All of the above

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
Any other ways you've tried to solve this (other addons, WeakAuras, macros, Blizzard UI options, etc.).

**Additional context**
- Screenshots, mockups, or videos of the desired UI/behavior
- Relevant game version / build if the request is version-specific
- Any compatibility concerns (other addons, Blizzard UI changes, etc.)
- How important is this to you / how often would you use it?
- Anything else that would help implement the request
